The officials denied the allegations, claiming the protest followed efforts to prevent tribals from constructing Indiramma houses on forest land.

candidates.excerpt: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke has called for a Tricolour protest at Delhi’s Connaught Place on October 16 over the arrest of party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, who were remanded to five days of judicial custody

Flydubai fallout: Air France complies with Israel’s ban on crew from Pakistan, 30 other countries
candidates.excerpt: Air France has confirmed it is complying with Israeli restrictions barring flight crew from 31 countries without diplomatic ties to Israel from flying to or over the country. The move follows a Flydubai incident involving an Omani co-pilot.
